_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the notes series (/notes/): one record per note. Rendered by scripts/render_notes.py (--check in CI, --write to regenerate the index and the Atom feed). Note pages themselves are hand-written at notes/<slug>/index.html; add the record here when a note is published.

notes.title: Three SEC comments, and what they found
notes.summary: Between October 19 and November 3, 2026, the program filed three comments with the Securities and Exchange Commission, 22 recommendations in all, on one premise: most of the facts a regulator needs about tokenized assets are already visible on public blockchains, so a rule can check those facts there instead of relying on what an issuer says about itself.

notes.title: October 19, 2026 filings: SEC Regulation Crypto Assets, Tokenized NMS Stock, and Treasury's Stablecoin Issuance Proposal
notes.summary: Between October 13 and October 19, 2026, the comment-letter program filed four submissions across three federal dockets (Treasury's proposed rule on who may issue and sell payment stablecoins, SEC Regulation Crypto Assets, and SEC tokenized NMS stock conditional exemptions), bringing the program to 25 letters across 19 dockets and 136 recommendations.

notes.title: GENIUS Act rules in October 2026: fourteen rulemakings, one in effect
notes.summary: The statutory deadline passed in July without a final rule. As of October 12, fourteen implementing rulemakings are tracked: one in effect, three open for comment and ten awaiting final action. The Act's effective date is now January 18, 2027 by its own formula.
